meta.name: The Mad Monster
meta.description:
From IMDb: A mad scientist changes his simple-minded handyman into a werewolf in order to prove his supposedly crazy scientific theories - and exact revenge.

Isn't that always the way?

Stars: Johnny Downs, George Zucco, Anne Nagel, and Glenn Strange

The 916MB MPEG4 file here was derived from the 3.8GB MPEG2 file found on this page. The reason being to provide a quality copy in a smaller size for downloading.
